data.body: AC amendment: Before updating message text, grep both files for any code that parses score= from review-status (not just the user-facing message strings): grep -n 'score=' plugins/dso/hooks/review-stop-check.sh plugins/dso/hooks/lib/session-misc-functions.sh. If any code reads score= for logic (not just display), update it to use severity-based logic instead.
